baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ordered construction moves from encounter at word 2, through bodily force at words 5-6 and disabling at word 9, to restraint at words 10-11, post-capture alternatives at words 13-16, and the endpoint at words 18-20.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah is a phase-governed state machine: reciprocal encounter permits force until effective resistance is immobilized; force then gives way to secure custody, and custody has two named exits, free release or ransom/exchange, under the larger terminus of war ceasing to carry its equipment.

activation_trace.role: A meeting of opposed parties supplies the reciprocal encounter that opens the sequence rather than an unbounded hunt.
Direct impact supplies the literal combat action at the sequence's force phase.
The anatomical neck fixes the force image on bodily vulnerability and also anticipates the person taken into custody.
Weighting and weakening until movement fails supplies the threshold that ends active striking.
Tightening a knot converts disabled opposition into controlled restraint.
A bond used to secure a captive supplies the custody state after the force threshold.
Release without compensation supplies one expressly nonlethal exit from custody.
Temporal succession marks release or ransom as later than capture and binding.
Ransom or captive exchange supplies the second expressly nonlethal exit from custody.
Putting a carried thing down supplies the terminal deactivation of war's load.
Active war and hostility define the bounded condition within which the preceding phases operate.
War equipment supplies the load whose being set down terminates the regime.

changed_reading.before: The line can initially sound like a continuous command to kill encountered opponents.
changed_reading.after: Its grammar instead stages bounded force with an explicit disabling threshold, a mandatory shift to custody, two nonlethal custody outcomes, and war's own cessation as the outer limit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The material progression at words 9-11 and 18-20 repeatedly changes movement, tightness, and weight.
baseline_models.mechanism: The battle is rendered as a material transition: mobile resistance is made heavy enough to stop, restraint is tightened and secured, captivity may be cut short by release, and war finally unloads. The commands therefore do not merely regulate persons; they dissipate a temporarily load-bearing war system.

activation_trace.role: Thickness and solidity provide the material image of fluid combat becoming arrested.
Strength and rigidity supply the tightening that stabilizes the custody phase.
Structural firmness makes restraint a controlled condition rather than continuing impact.
Cutting off an extension provides a secondary image for terminating captivity through release.
A heavy carried load turns war's endpoint into unloading, not merely winning.
Lowering a load into its resting place completes the material de-escalation.

changed_reading.before: The clauses can be read as separate battlefield and prisoner rules.
changed_reading.after: They cohere as a controlled phase transition that arrests motion, secures danger, cuts captivity short through named exits, and unloads the machinery and weight of war.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The counterfactual at words 23-25 redirects the sequence toward reciprocal testing at words 28-30, followed by the non-loss of the killed persons' works at words 32-38.
baseline_models.mechanism: Direct divine vindication is declared possible and therefore unnecessary as an explanation for human combat. Human beings are retained as parts acting upon parts so that condition becomes manifest; bodily death is not the metric of failure because intended work on the named path is protected from disappearance.

activation_trace.role: Effective will supplies the unrealized alternative of direct divine action.
Vindication against a wrongdoer specifies what direct action could have accomplished without human mediation.
Testing that makes condition appear supplies the stated purpose of reciprocal human exposure.
The alternate mapped inventory likewise presents ordeal as an examination that reveals quality, reinforcing disclosure rather than divine need.
Parts of a larger whole provide the reciprocal medium through which the community's differentiated conditions appear.
Actual loss of life supplies the maximal bodily interruption that still does not erase work.
An extended traversable path makes the preserved work directional rather than an isolated deed.
Disappearance and burial supply the loss explicitly denied of the dead persons' works.
Intentional action supplies the durable object preserved through bodily death.

changed_reading.before: Human combat might appear to be the necessary instrument of a victory God chooses not to perform directly.
changed_reading.after: The counterfactual removes necessity: reciprocal human exposure is itself the test, and the decisive outcome is the revealed and preserved quality of intentional work rather than survival alone.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The neck at word 6 is followed by plural object pronouns, binding, and legal custody outcomes rather than continued anatomical targeting.
baseline_models.mechanism: The neck branch spans the body part and the whole person, including captive and manumission usages. That semantic hinge supports the ayah's own transition: the exposed body in combat becomes a secured legal person whose status must be resolved by release or exchange.

activation_trace.role: The neck branch literally names the body part while extending to the whole captive person and acts of freeing.
Captive restraint converts the anatomical object of combat into a person under custody.
Uncompensated release supplies one legal resolution of the restrained person's status.
Captive exchange supplies the alternate legal resolution of that status.

changed_reading.before: The neck functions only as an anatomical target.
changed_reading.after: It also forms a body-to-person hinge: once resistance is ended, the vulnerable body is grammatically and legally reclassified as a captive whose release or exchange must be decided.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening context adds active diversion from a path to the repeated opponent designation, while the focus ayah closes by returning to that same path. The encounter is thereby framed as collision with path-obstruction, not as violence generated by an identity label in isolation.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal meeting anchors the revised model in the focus ayah's encounter construction.
The traversed path anchors both the killed persons' direction and the context's obstructed object.
Active concealment of truth supplies the repeated designation's contextual quality.
Turning others away supplies the active obstruction that conditions the later encounter.
The same path image identifies what the opponents are diverting people from.

structural_cues: 47:1 couples the opponent designation to diversion from the path, and 47:4 closes by naming that path again.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated designation-plus-obstruction and a return to the path; I infer that active obstruction frames the encounter, while the live alternative is that 47:1 describes only one contextual subset and does not formally narrow 47:4.

changed_reading.before: The encounter can be heard as category-triggered combat against whoever bears the designation.
changed_reading.after: The immediate frame makes it a collision with agents who cover truth and obstruct a traversable way; the violence answers an active contested trajectory, though the syntax itself does not state a legal qualification.

context_deltas.mechanism: The verses immediately after the focus carry the killed plural referent into repair of condition and onward entry, while later verses give the opposite pattern of works collapsing. Non-loss thus becomes active continuation and rehabilitation across bodily interruption, not merely archival credit.

activation_trace.role: Loss of life supplies the interruption across which the promised continuation must operate.
Disappearance supplies the fate explicitly denied of their works.
Purposive action is the object carried through death rather than erased by it.
Repair against corruption supplies an active sequel to the promise of non-loss.
Well-set condition supplies the state restored for the same plural referent.
Falling and collapse supply the contextual opposite of preserved work.
The repeated intentional works identify what can collapse in the contrast case.

structural_cues: 47:5-6 immediately continues the plural referent of those killed into guidance, repair, and entry; 47:8-9 supplies the opposite pattern of works being lost or made to collapse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pronoun continuity into repair and a contrastive work-collapse; I infer preservation as rehabilitated trajectory beyond death, while a simpler live alternative is posthumous reward without any process sense.

changed_reading.before: The final promise simply records that the slain will receive credit for prior deeds.
changed_reading.after: Their purposive trajectory is not allowed to disappear: it is carried through bodily loss into repaired condition, sharply contrasted with works that fall and lose efficacy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus denies that God needs humans in order to exact vindication; the nearby conditional support sequence instead couples human support with divine support and stabilized feet. Human agency remains the reciprocal testing medium, while effective steadiness is received rather than owned.

activation_trace.role: Effective divine will anchors the explicit possibility of bypassing human combat.
Direct vindication supplies the counterfactual action that is deliberately not the chosen mechanism.
Revelatory testing supplies the stated reason humans remain involved.
The alternate mapped test branch likewise makes human involvement an examination rather than a necessity.
The doubled support relation supplies conditional reciprocity between human service and divine aid.
Strengthening something into stability supplies the mode of divine aid within the human test.
Feet that bear and advance embody the human action stabilized by that aid.

structural_cues: 47:7 follows the counterfactual with an if-then symmetry of human support, divine support, and stabilized feet.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direct-action capacity, reciprocal support, and stabilization; I infer participatory rather than delegated-necessity agency, while the live alternative is a conventional promise of victory with no account of why mediation is chosen.

changed_reading.before: People fight as substitutes because direct divine action has been withheld.
changed_reading.after: Direct action is unnecessary but deliberately bypassed so people can become mutually revealing agents; divine aid operates inside that test as received steadiness, not autonomous human victory.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later context makes the mention and determination of fighting a diagnostic event before any battlefield outcome: hearers display impaired movement and a death-like gaze, resolve is demanded, and the sequence opens onto corruption, severed kinship, and locked hearts. The command's reception is therefore one arena of the focus ayah's reciprocal trial.

activation_trace.role: Testing that reveals condition anchors the later reception sequence in the focus ayah's stated purpose.
The alternate mapped examination branch supports reading reception itself as disclosure.
A firmly composed and decisive communication supplies the setting in which fighting is mentioned.
Mutual fighting supplies the announced content that triggers the diagnostic reaction.
Impaired force and shortened movement supply the latent condition exposed by the announcement.
Loss of force and life supplies the gaze-image through which inward fear becomes visible.
The heart's binding resolution supplies the demanded opposite of diagnostic recoil.
Departure from sound order supplies a possible social failure exposed around the command.
Severing a relation supplies the concrete social rupture that can accompany failed reception.
Kinship supplies the social bond placed at risk, contrasting with the focus ayah's regulated treatment of enemies and captives.
Closure and hardness supply the terminal image of a heart that cannot deliberate on the command.

structural_cues: 47:20-24 moves from mention of fighting to gaze, resolve, possible social rupture, deliberation, and locked hearts before returning to external opponents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies this reception sequence; I infer a diagnostic arc in which the discourse of fighting helps expose hearts, while the live alternative is that these verses list separate failings without making reception part of the trial in 47:4.

changed_reading.before: The reciprocal test occurs only when opposing bodies meet in battle.
changed_reading.after: The decisive mention of fighting already stages the test: fear, resolve, deliberation, and the risk of social severance become observable before combat, so readers of the command are among those being exposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's doubled part-language is later echoed by obedience in only part of an affair, immediately paired with hidden counsels. This refracts the reciprocal test from a simple clash of two complete camps into exposure of partial commitments and concealed alignments within collectivities.

activation_trace.role: Partitive division supplies the focus ayah's reciprocal arrangement of some through some.
A part rather than the whole supplies the later image of selective obedience and divided commitment.
Hidden inward content supplies what partial outward compliance can conceal and the trial can expose.

structural_cues: 47:26 places the promise to obey in only part of the affair beside divine knowledge of concealed counsels.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated part-language and secrecy; I infer thematic carry from reciprocal parts to internally divided allegiance, while the live alternative treats the repeated quantifier as ordinary wording with no cross-verse activation.

changed_reading.before: Some through some names two externally opposed and internally coherent groups.
changed_reading.after: It may also expose partiality within groups: selective obedience and secret alignment make each collectivity internally divisible, so the trial reveals fractures as well as sides.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late context supplies multiple output channels for latent condition: visible marks, recognizable speech inflection, effort under strain, restraint under pressure, and reports whose inner truth is tested. The reciprocal encounter in the focus ayah becomes a disclosure apparatus that converts hidden commitments into public evidence.

activation_trace.role: Testing that reveals actual quality anchors the disclosure mechanism in the focus ayah.
The alternate mapped examination branch independently supports manifestation of condition.
A visible identifying trace supplies one external channel by which hidden condition becomes knowable.
The alternate mapped inventory likewise supplies a sign by which its bearer is recognized.
Recognition from an effect or sign supplies the observer's uptake of disclosed condition.
A slant in speech toward its implication supplies an auditory channel for latent allegiance.
The doubled test explicitly repeats the focus mechanism around known human qualities and reports.
The alternate mapped examination branch preserves the same disclosure function in the repeated context occurrence.
Expended capacity under hardship supplies one behavior made observable by testing.
Self-restraint against panic supplies another latent quality externalized under pressure.
Knowledge of a report's inward reality supplies the informational object subjected to testing.

structural_cues: 47:30 lists marks and speech inflection as recognition channels; 47:31 repeats testing twice around strivers, the patient, and reports.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies observable signs, tone, tested effort, endurance, and reports; I infer that reciprocal conflict externalizes latent commitments rather than informing God of an unknown, while ordeal and recompense remain a live less-epistemic reading.

changed_reading.before: Testing means imposing hardship to sort people by whether they endure it.
changed_reading.after: Testing is also a public disclosure technology: encounter and pressure translate concealed commitments into marks, speech, exertion, restraint, and inspectable reports.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the context, works can fall, be actively nullified, or be diminished; the focus promise occupies the opposite pole. Death in the named path does not forfeit a faithful action's efficacy, but later warnings keep that durability morally contestable rather than automatic.

activation_trace.role: Loss from its owner supplies the forfeiture explicitly denied of the killed persons' works.
Intentional action supplies the trajectory whose persistence is at issue.
Collapse supplies one contextual mode by which opposed works lose standing.
The repeated object confirms that intentional works, not bodies, undergo collapse.
Active removal or nullification supplies a second contextual threat to work's efficacy.
The believers' own works make durability ethically contestable rather than a blanket property.
Deprivation that subtracts a right or work supplies the third loss mode explicitly negated.
The repeated works identify what divine accompaniment will not diminish.

structural_cues: The same plural object recurs in 47:32, 47:33, and 47:35 under three different predicates of collapse, nullification, and non-deprivation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated work-loss field; I infer durable causal or moral trajectory, while the live alternative restricts every occurrence to eschatological reward accounting.

changed_reading.before: The promise is a self-contained assurance of compensation for martyrdom.
changed_reading.after: It places faithful work on the durable side of a surah-wide persistence test: death does not forfeit it, although opposition and the agent's own nullifying conduct remain real threats to work elsewhere.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus mandates release or exchange after control and points to war's unloading; the later warning joins weakening with calling for peace while holding the upper position. The two can coexist if post-capture restraint is a disciplined phase of strength rather than collapse of resolve during active hostilities.

activation_trace.role: Uncompensated release supplies a merciful custody exit that does not itself declare strategic weakness.
Captive exchange supplies the alternate controlled exit after resistance has ended.
Active hostility supplies the regime whose ending remains the outer horizon.
Setting down a carried load anchors de-escalation in the focus ayah itself.
War equipment supplies what is ultimately to be laid aside.
Loss of force and slackened resolve supplies the prohibited condition attached to the later peace call.
Peace as the opposite of war supplies the later context's apparent tension with release and war's endpoint.
Prevailing position supplies the condition under which peace-seeking is warned against.

structural_cues: 47:4 orders release or exchange only after disabling and binding, whereas 47:35 syntactically joins weakening and calling toward peace while the addressees prevail.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nonlethal post-capture exits and a later conditioned peace warning; I infer a phase distinction between disciplined custody resolution and peace-as-loss-of-resolve, while a live alternative reads 47:35 as narrowing de-escalation more sharply.

changed_reading.before: Release or ransom can be generalized into an immediate directive to seek peace whenever possible.
changed_reading.after: The context resists that generalization: post-capture nonlethality and eventual unloading remain, but they coexist with resolve during active hostility and cannot simply be equated with a premature peace call.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the same impact root changes from figurative example-setting in 47:3 to literal combat in 47:4. It remains anchored in the focus noun and its immediate predecessor, but downstream prose should present an enacted-example resonance only, never replace the bodily sense of the focus construction.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The impact noun at word 5 immediately follows a contextual occurrence of the same root used with examples.

activation_trace.role: Literal impact anchors the outlier in the focus ayah's nonfigurative combat action.
Depicting and making an example visible supplies the immediately preceding figurative resonance.
A formally set example confirms the figurative construction paired with the prior impact-root occurrence.
An example functioning as lesson or sign supplies the possible public force of the bounded sequence that follows.

changed_reading.before: The focus impact is wholly detached from the preceding figurative use of the same root.
changed_reading.after: Without ceasing to be literal, the ordered force-to-custody sequence may also function as an enacted example of what bounded force looks like, carrying the prior verse's display function into conduct.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a later impact scene reverses agents and expands the target from necks to front and back. The repeated root visibly anchors the comparison, but the limit on human agency is reader-supplied; downstream prose should say the later scene can relativize human force, not that it explicitly legislates 47:4.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The human impact at word 5 is bounded by disabling and custody, whereas 47:27 assigns impact to angels at death.

activation_trace.role: Direct human impact supplies the local and phase-limited action whose agency is later reversed.
The neck supplies the focus scene's specific bodily exposure rather than comprehensive seizure.
The same direct-impact branch returns with angelic rather than human agents.
The presented front supplies one side of the later enclosing bodily scene.
The body's back supplies the complementary side, making the later seizure more encompassing.

changed_reading.before: Human battlefield impact carries the surah's full retributive weight.
changed_reading.after: A later agent reversal can make human force look local and provisional: encompassing retributive seizure belongs to angels, while the human act remains bounded by the focus ayah's transition to custody.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the packet's alternate mapped inventory for the war-load token rather than its ordinary weapons-and-burden inventory. It remains formally anchored to that exact focus occurrence and supplied split mapping, but downstream prose must label it a secondary spatial resonance, not a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Words 18-20 picture war putting down what it carries, and the token at word 20 has a supplied alternate mapping whose branch concerns deviation from a straight course.

activation_trace.role: Putting something into a lower resting place supplies the spatial action of cessation.
Weapons and war equipment preserve the ordinary load that is laid aside.
The alternate mapped branch supplies leaning away from a straight course as war's secondary distortion.

changed_reading.before: War ends only by putting down its weapons or burdens.
changed_reading.after: As a contained secondary image, war also ends by setting down the skew it imposes, allowing a return from deviation as its material load is removed.

strongest_changes: The focus ayah became a bounded state transition from force to custody and named nonlethal exits, not a continuous violence formula.
The divine counterfactual shifted the purpose from necessary victory to reciprocal disclosure, later made visible through marks, speech, effort, endurance, and reports.
The non-loss of works became active continuity and repair across bodily death within a wider field where works can collapse, be nullified, or be preserved.
Later reception scenes placed hearers of the fighting command inside the trial, while the peace warning preserved a live tension between post-capture restraint and resolve during active war.
summary.what_was_special: Immediate root repetition made literal impact resonate with example-setting, later context reversed impact agency to angels, and the supplied split inventory for war's load preserved an exploratory image of cessation as setting down distortion. The most coherent latent pattern was not victory but conversion of hidden condition into observable evidence under tightly phased force.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the adjacent example-setting resonance is rhetorically intended or only a packet-licensed lexical echo.
Whether preserved works primarily mean reward, continuing causal efficacy, remembered testimony, or several of these at once.
How sharply 47:35 limits the release, exchange, and war-ending horizon of 47:4 rather than distinguishing strategic phases.
Whether the alternate mapped image of war's tilt deserves any downstream rendering beyond an explicitly experimental resonance.
